\title{Is one run enough? Decision-level reliability of single-run SHAP attributions on tabular models}
\author{Anonymous Authors}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

\begin{abstract}
Feature attributions are usually computed once, by a randomised, budget-limited estimator, and read as if they were the attribution.
We ask how far one SHAP run is a reliable basis for the conclusion a reader draws from it: the top feature, the top-$k$ set or a sign.
Against the exact Shapley value of a fixed value function, we measure per instance how often a run returns the exact top-3 set, with and without tolerance for near ties, for four model classes on five tabular datasets.
At the \texttt{shap} default budget, on the two datasets large enough to be sampled ($40$ and $60$ instances, one trained model each), a run returns the exact top-3 set with probability at least $0.9$ for $0.90$--$1.00$ of the instances of every cell, and for all of them once near-tie swaps are forgiven; the exceptions are small-margin instances that mean correlation with the exact values would not flag.
With three to four times as many coalitions as features the tolerance-aware share is $0.65$--$0.97$ for the non-linear models, and near zero at twice as many.

shown.message:
I requested changes on paper-repo#9 (candidate v1). The PDF has a Type 3 font on 19 pages, and the NeurIPS kit requires Type 1 or embedded TrueType only.

- **The miss:** `\texttt` is set in a bitmap Type 3 font under the T1 font encoding on this TeX Live. The style's own anonymous e-mail line and every `\texttt{shap}` in the paper use it. The fix is one line: add `\usepackage{courier}` after `\usepackage{neurips_2026}` in `paper/main.tex`. I tested it on the unmodified style and the PDF was Type 1 only afterwards.
- **My earlier error:** `VENUE.md` said the unmodified kit compiled to Type 1 only. That was wrong for this case. I corrected it and gave the fix (venue-repo `main`).
- **What the build meets:**
  - **Length:** the main text ends on page 9 and References start at the top of page 10. The checklist is on page 12 and the appendix sits outside the limit.
  - **Format:** US Letter, the style with no option, and "Anonymous Author(s)". The `template/` files match the official kit.
  - **Anonymity and checklist:** no identifying URLs or names in the sources, 38 checklist answers present, and no TODO left.
- **Advisory, not a venue rule:** figure text goes down to 5.4 pt on pages 6 and 8, below `figtab-repo`'s own 6 pt floor and my 7 pt recommendation. The page-9 fit has little slack, so any added text needs a page-count recheck.

This reviews the document build of `paper-repo` `dev` commit f1030cdbe697, which is the same commit as `candidate-v1`.
